description: A check-your-inbox screen after signup, with open mail and resend actions and a cooldown timer.
overview: A check-your-inbox screen shown after signup that names the address the link went to, with an Open Mail button, a Resend button with a 45-second cooldown and a link to change the address. Use it for email verification, magic links or password reset confirmations.
usage: Pass the real address in place of the `EMAIL` constant. In the demo, Open Mail marks the email as verified, but in production verification happens when the user follows the link, so point that button at a mail app or remove it. Connect Resend to your email service and `#change` to your account settings.
